svg.title: GuitarDAWLiteOS codec and clock sheet (ADC-as-master, bench modules)
svg.desc: Pi 5 J8 header as I2S slave, CJMCU-1808 breakout as bus master clocked by a Nano ESP32 MCLK, and GY-PCM5102 DAC, with every pin assigned to a net and its drive direction. Nets joined by name.
svg.text: Nano ESP32 · U4
D2 (GPIO5) -33R-> MCLKGND x2 . GND (star)VIN . +9 V rail
CJMCU-1808 · U2 (MASTER)

SCK <- MCLK via 33R (12.288 MHz)MD1 . +3V3 (master…)MD0 . +3V3 (…256 fs)FMT . GND (I²S)BCK -> BCLK (drives, 3.072M)LRC -> LRCLK (drives, 48k)OUT -> CAPDAT+5V <- +5V via RC (analog VCC)3.3 <- +3V3 (digital VDD)GND x2 . GND (both pins)LIN <- front-end (Rs+Ca here)– . GND (input reference)RIN . n/c (rev-B tape return)
straps set BEFORE power-on;
never 5 V on a 3.3 pin (4 V max)
Pi 5 J8 · SLAVE (I2S1)
p12 GPIO18 <- BCLKp35 GPIO19 <- LRCLKp38 GPIO20 <- CAPDATp40 GPIO21 -> PLAYDATp2 -> +5Vp1 -> +3V3p6 . GND (STAR point)
AltFn4 pads, bSlave=TRUE
GY-PCM5102 · U3
VIN <- +5V RAW (not via 10R)GND . GNDSCK . GND (int. PLL)BCK <- BCLKLCK <- LRCLKDIN <- PLAYDATFLT pad . LDEMP pad . LXSMT pad . H (unmute!)FMT pad . LOUT L/R/G -> line out
Notes
Nets joined by name: MCLK · BCLK · LRCLK · CAPDAT · PLAYDAT · +5V · +3V3 · GND.
Arrow = who drives the net; "." = strap / tie / no-connect.
One clock domain, rooted at the Nano's crystal: the ADC divides MCLK by 256 → 48 kHz
LRCLK and by 4 → 3.072 MHz BCLK — everyone else follows.
Power: J8 p2 SPLITS -- DAC VIN direct from p2; ADC +5V via 10R, with 470uF + 0.1uF to star (A1). ADC ONLY.
(DAC 25mA through the 10R would sag ADC VCC under its 4.5V min.) TL072 = own 9V domain.
STAR GND at Pi p6: ADC GND + "–" pad, DAC GND, Nano GND, CopperSound rail —
ONE DC point. Paired/twisted HF returns beside MCLK and BCK/LRC/OUT are required, not "islands".
Rev-A KiCad HAT sheet (Pi-as-master, on-HAT bare chips) predates the clock pivot;
this sheet is the as-built bench truth.
